about.en: SWAP is the token of TrustSwap, a Web3 company founded in 2020 that runs the TrustSwap Launchpad for token sales and is the parent of Team Finance (token locking and vesting infrastructure) and The Crypto App. SWAP is staked for launchpad allocation tiers. It is the ERC-20 token at 0xCC4304A31d09258b0029eA7FE63d032f52e44EFe on Ethereum, with deployments on BNB Chain, Polygon and Avalanche; some venues list it as TRUSTSWAP.
